conventions: TypeScript + Bun 5-package monorepo (@super-work/core, @super-work/drivers, @super-work/server, @super-work/cli, @super-work/web). Mirror new core/server capabilities across REST, CLI, MCP, and bilingual zh-CN/en Web UI without adding third-party dependencies.
